name: a2b-marketplace
description: Personal plugin marketplace for A2B / Mayz. Holds spec-crystallizer, legacy-code-explorer, comment-cleanup, git-weekly-report, and any future skills and plugins.

plugins.name: spec-crystallizer
plugins.description: Non-leading spec interviewer plus a zero-context cold-read critic. Externalize what's in your head, catch the gaps a fresh reader hits, stop at MVP-ready.

plugins.name: legacy-code-explorer
plugins.description: Explores legacy code before you refactor it: answers questions about flow, UI, and logic coupling, grades refactor risk per area, and writes a markdown knowledge document.

plugins.name: comment-cleanup
plugins.description: Strips agent-left scratch comments and comments that just restate self-evident code, keeping only the ones that explain a genuinely non-obvious WHY.

plugins.name: git-weekly-report
plugins.description: Slash commands that turn git history into a weekly radar: per-repo activity/Issues&Fixes reports, plus a multi-repo project rollup (via bare mirrors) that flags risk building up before it's an incident. Pairs with a scheduled Routine for a fully automatic weekly report.
